mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeds 5.0%, it signals persistent inflation requiring aggressive monetary tightening, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate and federal funds rate signal economic contraction reducing corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in 30 days
regime_hint: dual pressure regime (labor market weakness and monetary tightening)
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp and FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp over 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A housing market slowdown (HOUST < 1400 thousand units and RSAFS < 650 billion dollars) reduces consumer spending on durable goods, lowering corporate revenue growth and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1400 and RSAFS < 650000.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals labor market weakness reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production and housing starts signal supply chain disruption reducing corporate output and earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls > 0.5% and HOUST falls > 0.5% in 30 days
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO falls > 0.5% and HOUST falls > 0.5% over 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a high interest rate and high inflation regime (FEDFUNDS > 3.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%), restrictive monetary policy increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
regime_hint: high interest rate and high inflation regime
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 3.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly decline in real GDP (GDPC1) signals economic contraction reducing corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 declines quarter-over-quarter.
